mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, resulting in higher S&P 500 valuations and positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 3.0% in current period but 20-day forward return negative in >50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% but 5-day forward return positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS increase >0.5% month-over-month but 20-day forward return negative in >50% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), strong employment supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) but 60-day forward return negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth positive but 20-day forward return negative in >50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) below 1700.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1700.0 but 5-day forward return positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) and high rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) regimes, central bank focus on inflation control reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: High inflation/high rates regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) but 20-day forward return positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic momentum, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive growth but 60-day forward return negative in >50% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.
